purpose: canonical team-composition identity, reused across the players and events that fielded it

fields.name: team_list_id
fields.description: Primary key; Limitless' own canonical team-list id

fields.name: tournament_count
fields.description: Distinct tournaments at which this exact composition was fielded

fields.name: player_count
fields.description: Distinct players who fielded this exact composition

fields.name: best_placement
fields.description: Best (lowest) final standing achieved with this composition

fields.name: first_seen_date
fields.description: Earliest tournament date this composition appears at (YYYY-MM-DD)

fields.name: first_seen_tournament_id
fields.description: Limitless tournament id for that earliest appearance

fields.name: first_seen_event_id
fields.description: RK9/MunchStats event_id for that appearance; the join key to tournament_event

fields.name: regulation_set
fields.description: Regulation set the composition was played under, e.g. "m-a"

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Provenance: source URL for this record

fields.name: extracted_at_utc
fields.description: Provenance: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the extraction run

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Provenance: dataset version this record was published under
